A librarian hears a sour note when a charming rogue convinces Iowa townspeople to start a boys marching band.

programme.desc: The judge's (Lewis Stone) son (Mickey Rooney) goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart (Bonita Granville) is engaged to someone else.
programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy

programme.desc: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.
programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner

programme.desc: A lawyer (Ginger Rogers) bails out and then marries a Hollywood tough guy (Jack Carson) who's a milquetoast in real life.
programme.title: The Groom Wore Spurs

programme.desc: A goofy astronaut (Don Knotts) with a fear of heights becomes assistant janitor, then goes on a space mission.
programme.title: The Reluctant Astronaut

programme.desc: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.
programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story

programme.desc: Moe, Larry and Curly Joe circle the globe with Phileas Fogg III and his girlfriend.
programme.title: The Three Stooges Go Around the World in a Daze

programme.desc: A music professor (Ryan O'Neal) visits San Francisco with his fiancée (Madeline Kahn) and meets a kooky woman (Barbra Streisand).
programme.title: What's Up, Doc?

programme.desc: Two buddies win a car and head for Hollywood to meet Anita Ekberg.
programme.title: Hollywood or Bust

programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole

programme.title: Oh, Susanna

programme.title: The Ladies' Man

programme.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
